mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `cors`.`reservations` (user_email, shop_id, visit_date, status) VALUES (#{reservation.userEmail}, #{reservation.shopId}, #{reservation.visitDate}, #{reservation.status})
mapper.select: SELECT t1.`shop_id` AS `shopId`, t1.`id` AS `reservationId`, t4.`shop_name` AS `shopName`, t3.`id` AS `itemId`, t2.`size` AS `size`, t3.`item_name` AS `itemName`, t3.`color` AS `color`, t3.`price` AS `price`, t1.`visit_date` AS `visitDate`, t1.`status` AS `status`, (SELECT img.`image_path` FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` img WHERE img.`product_id` = t3.`id` LIMIT 1) AS `imagePath` FROM `cors`.`reservations` AS t1 JOIN `cors`.`reservation_items` AS t2 ON t1.`id` = t2.`reservation_id` LEFT JOIN `cors`.`shop_items` AS t3 ON t2.`item_id` = t3.`id` LEFT JOIN `cors`.`shop_info` AS t4 ON t1.`shop_id` = t4.`shop_id` WHERE t1.`user_email` = #{email} ORDER BY t1.`visit_date` DESC
